work.title: Untitled (Page on Targets)
work.description: Mixed-media collage centering a white rectangular panel mounted with two silver compact discs and a translucent form, bordered by concentric target circles in red, black, pink, and blue. Scattered elements include a black chess king figure, football fragments, printed text reading 'xxxiii dia,' additional CDs, and horizontal bands of graphic patterning along the perimeter.
work.composition: central pinned page on target field
